grouping.rule: new group iff consecutive observed timestamp gap > 30 days
grouping.missing_timestamps: excluded from temporal grouping; counted separately
grouping.rule_evidence: preliminary_grouped/analyze.py (CPython 3.12 test_histories bytecode): Jan1,Jan1,Jan2,Feb1 form size4 group; Mar3 is separate

history.construction: train + observed validation item; test target excluded
history.duplicates: retained exactly as original preliminary preprocessing

interpretation: Temporal groups supplement the existing four figures; they are not the original semantic KMeans preference clusters. A 30-day consecutive-gap group can span more than 30 days.

five_figure_method.alignment: mean excess_cosine_z within user/group, then equal mean across users
five_figure_method.preference: mean original semantic-cluster excess match within user/group; original per-user 1/K chance retained
five_figure_method.influence: mean original single-item deletion margin effect within user/group; NOT joint group ablation
five_figure_method.coverage: sum positive original excess cosine z per group; cumulative recent groups / all positive signal in observed history
five_figure_method.confidence_interval: 95% user bootstrap for alignment/preference/influence; coverage shading is user IQR
five_figure_method.cohorts: original test history and max100 items; fixed_K16 means at least16 original items, not16 groups
